intro: Quick answers to what people ask most about GTA 6. Times and prices adjust to where you are.

sources.title: Rockstar Games – Grand Theft Auto VI official site
Dexerto – GamesBeat report on the PC version (Q1 2027)
PCWorld – PC report, Rockstar did not comment
Timesaver – prices in the UK, Europe, Canada and Australia
Netto's Game Room – Xbox Cloud Gaming on Xbox One

items.a: At midnight local time on Thursday 19 November 2026 in most countries, starting with New Zealand. The US and Canada unlock together at midnight Eastern, which is 9 PM Pacific on the 18th. Where you are, it unlocks {unlock}.
The Standard Edition is $79.99 in the US, £69.99 in the UK and €79.99 in the eurozone. Ultimate is $99.99, £89.99 or €99.99. Prices for {country}: {std} Standard, {ult} Ultimate.

Not at launch. Rockstar hasn't announced a PC version. GamesBeat reported in October 2026, citing four sources, that a PC release is planned for January to March 2027. Rockstar didn't comment, so treat that as unconfirmed.
Not at launch. Rockstar calls GTA 6 a single-player experience and hasn't announced an online mode. Any dates you see are rumours.
PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Xbox One owners can stream it through Xbox Cloud Gaming. There's no PS4 or Switch version.

items.q: What frame rate does it run at?
items.a: Rockstar targets 30 frames per second on both PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, with extra PS5 Pro features.
210 GB on PS5, going by the PlayStation Store listing. Leave some extra room for the day-one patch. The Xbox size hasn't been announced. Pre-loading opened on 10 November for digital pre-orders.

items.q: Does the physical edition come with a disc?
items.a: No. Boxed copies contain a download code instead of a disc.

items.q: Can I still get the pre-order bonus?
items.a: The Vintage Vice City Pack comes with every digital purchase made before 20 November 2026, and with boxed copies while stocks last.

items.q: Is the Ultimate Edition worth it?
items.a: It adds 16 extras for {diff} more: cars, weapons, outfits, shops and two side activities. Nothing in it is needed to finish the game, so Standard is enough if you only care about the story.
Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, and you can switch between them. The supporting cast includes Cal Hampton, Brian and Lori Heder, Boobie Ike, Dre'Quan Priest, Real Dimez and Raul Bautista.
In Leonida, Rockstar's version of Florida: Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga National Park.

items.q: How many wanted stars are there?
items.a: Six, up from five in GTA V.
Nobody knows until people play it. GTA V had cheats but no money cheat. Any GTA 6 cheat list published before launch is made up.
No. Take-Two has said it won't be on Xbox Game Pass at launch.
Rockstar says single-player launches without microtransactions.
